# Converter

> The Universal, 100% Client-Side Document & AST Conversion Engine.

Converter is an open-source web application designed to normalize and convert chaotic AI outputs (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek), LaTeX documents and resumes, GitHub Flavored Markdown, and HTML into clean, presentation-ready Word (.doc), PDF, Markdown, and HTML documents entirely in the client browser with zero telemetry or data collection.

## Key Capabilities

- **LLM Mixed Stream Engine:** Solves the common problem of AI chatbots mixing raw LaTeX math delimiters ($$...$$, \[...\], \(...\)), broken code fences, and ASCII tables into unformatted text. Converter compiles them into native typography on the fly.
- **Overleaf & LaTeX Resume Support:** Natively parses academic CV and resume templates (Jake's Resume, sb2nov) into editable Microsoft Word (.doc) and PDF documents with bullet lists, hyperlinks, and contact blocks intact.
- **Dual-MIME Clipboard:** Direct copy-paste into Microsoft Word, Google Docs, Notion, Obsidian, and Slack with preserved formulas and tables.
- **Zero Telemetry Privacy:** 100% local execution in browser sandbox. No server uploads, no accounts, no tracking.

## Interactive Tools & Resources

- [Converter Web Application](https://converter-sr.vercel.app/): Main interactive converter tool in the browser.
- [Full LLM Specification & Documentation](https://converter-sr.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): Complete reference manual and schema details for AI agents.
- [Open Source GitHub Repository](https://github.com/SniperRavan/Converter): Source code, parser architecture, and issue tracker.
- [Overleaf Resume to Word Guide](https://converter-sr.vercel.app/#guide): Step-by-step tutorial on converting academic resumes to ATS-friendly Word docs.
- [Report Issues & Contact](https://github.com/SniperRavan/Converter/issues): Submit bug reports or request new parsers.

## Supported Input Formats

- [LLM Mixed Stream](https://converter-sr.vercel.app/#converter): Raw streaming output from ChatGPT, Claude, DeepSeek, and Gemini.
- [LaTeX Documents & Formulas](https://converter-sr.vercel.app/#converter): Overleaf CVs, equations, and mathematical papers.
- [Markdown](https://converter-sr.vercel.app/#converter): GitHub Flavored Markdown (tables, checklists, footnotes, math).
- [HTML5 Documents](https://converter-sr.vercel.app/#converter): Clean HTML structures.
- [JSON AST](https://converter-sr.vercel.app/#converter): Normalized document Abstract Syntax Tree.

## Supported Output Formats

- [Microsoft Word (.docx / .doc)](https://converter-sr.vercel.app/#converter): Native Office OpenXML (.docx) and MSOffice XML with editable OMML equations and formatted tables.
- [Print-Ready PDF (.pdf)](https://converter-sr.vercel.app/#converter): High-fidelity PDF with pagination and embedded KaTeX styles.
- [Clean Markdown (.md)](https://converter-sr.vercel.app/#converter): Normalized standard Markdown.
- [Semantic HTML5 (.html)](https://converter-sr.vercel.app/#converter): Sanitized HTML ready for web publishing.
- [LaTeX Source (.tex)](https://converter-sr.vercel.app/#converter): Clean LaTeX markup.
- [JSON AST (.json)](https://converter-sr.vercel.app/#converter): Document syntax tree.
